episodes.title: The Number That Did Not Belong

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Sir, stop. This attachment has an order from a tribunal I cannot find in the filing menu.
lines.sfx_cue: thick file slapped onto counter, rubber stamp stops

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Give me the bundle.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: The applicant wants the main affidavit taken today. He says this order is only supporting material.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Then I want to know what it supports.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Possession, sir. The affidavit says possession changed because of this award.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Read the issuing authority.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Arbitration and Dispute Resolution Forum. Presiding Officer.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Which district?

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: It... it does not say.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Which appointing court?

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: There is no appointment page attached.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Case number.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: A D R F, slash, one seven six, slash, twenty-three.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: That is not one of ours.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Should I return the filing? The counter is full, sir.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Accept the main affidavit provisionally. Detach nothing. Mark the complete bundle for scrutiny.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Under which defect code?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Do not invent a defect because the menu is inconvenient. Write, authority not traceable.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Authority not traceable. Yes, sir.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: And bring me the register for court-appointed arbitrators.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The attachment had arrived as page forty-three of a file about something else. That was why nobody had hidden it.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Current register, sir. Retired appointments are in the bound volumes.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Start with the forum name.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: There are six panels using the words dispute resolution. None with this full name.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Search by the case number.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Our arbitration references do not begin with A D R F.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Search anyway.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Yes, sir.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: No result in district appointments. No result in transferred appointments. No result in closed references.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Now search the presiding officer's surname.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: It is not printed clearly. The seal crosses the signature.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The typed line beneath it.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Only, Presiding Officer.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: A title without a name.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Maybe it is a private panel, sir. Parties do create private panels.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Private panels identify the arbitrator. Courts identify the appointing order. This identifies neither.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: There is a registry-clerk certification on the last page.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Read it.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Certified that the proceedings above were recorded before the presiding officer, and that the award is a true copy.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Name of the clerk?

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: A signature. Initial S. The rest is a long stroke.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Address?

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Second floor, above a tyre shop. No building number.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: A tribunal without a district, an arbitrator without a name, and a registry above a tyre shop.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Should I call the number on the seal?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Sir, if it is false—

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: We do not write false because something looks cheap. We write what the record proves.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: The record proves nothing exists under that name.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: The record proves we have not found it. Those are different sentences.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By four thirty, three registers had failed to explain one sheet of paper.
lines.sfx_cue: office wall clock ticking, distant court bell

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Bring the index of ad hoc appointments for the last five years.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: That index is handwritten, sir. It will take until closing.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Closing is a time. It is not permission to stop.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Yes, sir.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Sir, the applicant is asking why his affidavit is held.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: It is not held. It is under scrutiny.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: He says the other order was obeyed months ago. He has attached the handover receipt.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Show me.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: The losing party signed for payment and delivered possession.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Was counsel present before this forum?

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: The appearance sheet lists an advocate.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Then this was not one confused man carrying a paper to a frightened shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: No, sir.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: How many annexures refer to the forum?

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Three. The award, the payment receipt, and the possession memorandum.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: All bearing the same case number?

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Yes, sir. One seven six.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Do not discuss it at the counter.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: I already asked two clerks if they knew the forum.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: And now half the corridor knows there is a paper we cannot identify.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: I... I was trying to clear the defect, sir.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: You did correctly by bringing it. You did incorrectly by making it corridor entertainment.

lines.speaker: FILING CLERK
lines.text: Sorry, sir.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Return to your counter. Say only that scrutiny is pending.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The public counters closed. The unidentified order remained open on the registrar's desk.
lines.sfx_cue: metal shutters rattling down in distant corridor

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Sir, I checked every ad hoc appointment since twenty-eighteen. The forum name is absent.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: And the case number?

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: It belongs to no sequence maintained here.

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Leave the bundle with me.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Do you want a formal verification note?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Tomorrow. First I want to see whether the number appears again.

lines.speaker: RECORDS ASSISTANT
lines.text: Where will you keep it?

lines.speaker: hardik
lines.text: Not the file. Only the number.
lines.sfx_cue: small paper slip torn from pad

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He wrote A D R F, slash, one seven six, slash, twenty-three on the slip, and put it in his drawer.
lines.sfx_cue: pencil scratching, wooden drawer sliding shut

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Registry clerk, put your stamp here. Beneath your signature. Let everyone see what you certified.
lines.sfx_cue: rubber stamp struck hard on wooden desk

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Why? The copy already has my signature.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: That is precisely why I want the stamp.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The certified copy has been issued. Do not create theatre at my counter.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Your counter has produced enough theatre. I am asking the clerk to read one sentence.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir, should I give him another copy or not?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No. The matter is complete.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Then answer her. What does her signature certify?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You appeared in one matter and received an award. You do not supervise my staff.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: I am trying to ensure your staff knows what you made her sign.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I know. It says I recorded the proceedings.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Did you?

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I called the numbers. I wrote who came. I kept the files.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Did you record every statement printed in these proceedings?

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Not every word. Sir dictates the order later.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Louder, please. The parties behind me paid to hear this court.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I said, he dictates later.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Then what did she certify?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Silence. This is a registry, not a tea stall.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: A registry of which court?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A private dispute resolution forum. You knew that when your client signed consent.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: I knew the parties could appoint an arbitrator. I asked you for the appointment order.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: And I told you consent cured the absence of a prior order.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: You told me there was no prior appointment. Your clerk was standing beside you.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Yes. I heard that.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: That matter is closed.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Her signature is on matters she did not hear, beneath a seal that does not name an appointing authority. Her matter is not closed.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Sir... what is he saying?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He is retiring without enough clients. Today he has chosen to perform for mine.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Good. Humiliate me. But tell the girl what the words mean.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: We are waiting for our case. Why is nobody answering her?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: All matters are adjourned until two. Clear the room.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: There are seven people waiting. Two came from outside the city.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Clear the room, clerk.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: There. He remembers your designation when he needs obedience.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Please leave. Everyone, please. We will call you after two.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN ROOM
lines.text: Fourteen months she has sat here, and today she learns what her own stamp means.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I said leave.
lines.sfx_cue: door pulled open, footsteps filing out

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: Keep one uncertified copy for yourself. Do not let him take it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Get out.

lines.speaker: advocate
lines.text: I am going. She still remains on every page.
lines.sfx_cue: walking stick tapping away, door closing

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Lock it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: The door. You said clear the room. Lock it.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Now tell me what my signature means.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It means you issued a true copy from our file.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: He asked whether I recorded every statement.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Clerks certify proceedings. It is routine.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Which clerks? Court clerks?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Registry clerks.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: In a registered tribunal?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Private arbitration does not require the kind of registration you imagine.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Then show me your appointment.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Not this again.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Show me one page. Court appointment, party appointment, any appointment with your name.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Each consent memorandum appoints the forum for that dispute.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: The forum. Not you.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I am the presiding officer of the forum.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Who made you presiding officer?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I established the forum.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You made the room, then the room appointed you?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not reduce legal arrangements to foolish sentences.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Then give me the clever sentence. I have asked four times.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Parties came voluntarily. They argued. They accepted decisions. You saw them comply.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: That is not an appointment.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It is jurisdiction by consent.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Is this a court?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: People use the word court loosely.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You use it. Every day. You say, call the court to order.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It creates discipline.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You made me say, all persons having business before this court.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A formal opening helps parties behave.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You made me stand when you entered.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not say made. I gave you a respectable designation when nobody else would interview you.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: There. That is the answer you were saving.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It is the truth. You had never worked. You could not type properly. I trained you.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: And because I was grateful, you put my name where you would not put yours.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: My signature is on every award.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Under a title. The title hides your name. My certification does not hide mine.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Nobody is coming for you.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Someone already asked for the appointment order.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: An old advocate asked. He left with nothing.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: And if a real registry asks?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Why would it? We choose private disputes. We do not interfere with pending court matters.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: How do you know what is pending?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I check.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Where? I have never seen you check any public website.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: That is administrative work. It does not concern your certification.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Everything suddenly does not concern me, except the signature.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You were paid to maintain records, and you maintained them.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Paid. Yes.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: One envelope for the first month. Three thousand rupees.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Second month. Three thousand.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Then four thousand, after you said the registry was growing.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You earned every rupee.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Fourteen salary envelopes. Fourteen months calling case numbers I did not understand.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You understand them now. They are disputes resolved faster than any district court could resolve them.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: And these certified copies went outside this room?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Parties take copies. Naturally.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Banks? Land offices? Police stations? Real courts?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I do not follow every party after judgment.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: But my signature follows them.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Listen to me. No one was cheated. Manjula got her keys. Irfan got his home. People obey because the decisions are fair.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Fair does not make you appointed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not repeat that advocate's language as if you studied law overnight.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I did not study law. That is why you chose me.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I chose you because you were reliable.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: No. You chose me because I would sign before I knew what to ask.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sarika—

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Do not call me by my name now. Answer one thing.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Ask.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Can I be jailed for this?

lines.speaker: POSTMAN
lines.text: Registered official communication. The presiding officer must sign personally.
lines.sfx_cue: metal stairwell door banging, registered envelope tapped against clipboard

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: He is inside. What office sent it?

lines.speaker: POSTMAN
lines.text: District court registry. I need his signature, not yours.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Give it here.

lines.speaker: POSTMAN
lines.text: Sign on the line. Full signature. Date beneath it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Is acknowledgement required?

lines.speaker: POSTMAN
lines.text: Already required, sir. That is why I climbed above the tyre shop.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You may go.

lines.speaker: POSTMAN
lines.text: Your copy, sir.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Open it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: There are people waiting upstairs.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: They can wait. The district court did not send registered post to admire our nameplate.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Return to the desk.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I asked yesterday if I could be jailed. You did not answer. Open it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Lower your voice.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Open it before I tear it open myself.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It is addressed to me.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Read it aloud.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The registrar seeks clarification regarding an arbitral award attached to a filing under scrutiny.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Which award?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Case one seven six.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: The builder's land matter.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: The matter where the advocate asked for your appointment.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Read the rest yourself.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You are directed to provide a certified copy of the order appointing the named presiding officer, the consent reference, and the registration particulars of the forum.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: There is a consent memorandum.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: It asks for three things. We have one.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Consent is the foundation. The other particulars can be explained.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Within eleven days from receipt.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I can read.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Eleven days to provide a document that never existed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Do not say that outside this stairwell.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Inside the room, you said nobody was coming for us.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: They have asked for clarification. That is not an accusation.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: What will you send?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I will reconstruct the authority from the consent papers.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Reconstruct means type it now and date it earlier.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: It means regularise the record.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Will my signature be on it?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: Then whose?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Go upstairs. Call the first matter.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: I will call nothing until you answer.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: If the waiting parties hear panic in your voice, you will create the very problem you fear.

lines.speaker: sarika
lines.text: You created it. My voice only calls the number.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He cancelled the morning list and carried the registrar's letter to the copying room where the trouble had begun.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: You should not be here during working hours.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I need eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: You always need something that sounds smaller when counted.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The district registrar has one of my awards.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: One seven six. The land award.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: That was not from my envelope.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: No. It came independently.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Then independently solve it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: He wants the appointment order.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Show me the letter.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I need an old inward number. Something from before the first award.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: You need a number from a register you never entered.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: A miscellaneous arbitration reference. One that was closed without hearing. We can correct the party names.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: We?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You know the registers. I will prepare the language.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: You want to place a new appointment inside an old court record.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I want to regularise an appointment the parties already accepted.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: No. Say the sentence properly. You want me to forge a judicial record.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Keep your voice down.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Why? Your court is above a tyre shop. Mine has vigilance officers.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Your pending list built my docket.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: My list kept you away from cases that could expose you.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: And I paid your price every month.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Did you?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I opened every sealed envelope. I asked no questions.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Opening was not the price.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I heard the matters you sent.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: And ruled as each envelope instructed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The rulings were legally supportable.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: One envelope said release the deposit. You released it. One said restrain the workshop owner. You restrained him.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: After hearing both sides.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: One said award sixty percent of the disputed stock to the supplier. Your order said sixty percent.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Because the invoices proved sixty percent.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Your reasons changed. My result never did.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You brought disputes that needed quick resolution.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: I brought outcomes people paid to receive.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You told me never to ask who.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: And you enjoyed not asking. It let you sit higher than the people paying you.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: How much did you take from them?

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: There. Fourteen months, and today you discover curiosity.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: How much?

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Enough that they expected the exact operative line. Not advice. Not fairness. The line inside the envelope.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: If those matters are examined, you are inside every one.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: My name is not on an award.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: The pending list came from your custody.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: A photographed list proves you had a camera. Your signed orders prove what you did with it.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You cannot step away now.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: I can step away before the registrar asks his second question.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Help me answer the first one. One inward entry. One certified copy. After that, we stop.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: There is no after that. A false entry needs a false dispatch. A false dispatch needs a missing page. Missing pages make clerks remember faces.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You have replaced pages before.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: You do not know what I have done. That ignorance was part of our arrangement.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I kept every envelope.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Empty paper covers and your own orders. Keep them. Frame them behind your dais.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I can tell the registrar where I obtained his pending list.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Of course. And I can give him the names in twelve envelopes, the results requested, and the results you signed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You said one envelope a month and no questions. You never said I was taking instructions.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: The first envelope contained a case number and one sentence. You copied that sentence into your award. What question remained?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I... I changed the wording.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Not the winner.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Those parties had consented to my authority.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Then show the registrar your authority.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: That is why I came.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: And that is why you are leaving.
lines.sfx_cue: official letter lifted from copier glass

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You owe me time.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: I gave you a pending list worth thirty-two pages. You gave my clients twelve outcomes. Our account is closed.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Eleven days. Give me one old number and I will never come back.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: I will not touch your appointment order.

lines.speaker: pandit
lines.text: Bring back the pending list.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Hardik received a filing bundle containing an award from an unfamiliar forum and directed that its authority be traced.

state_changes.fact: became aware of an award issued under an unrecognized forum name
entered district court scrutiny as an attached award

beat_sheet.what_happened: Hardik found no matching forum, appointment, arbitrator name or case-number sequence in the available district records.

state_changes.fact: could not trace the forum or case number in district records
lacked a traceable appointing record

beat_sheet.what_happened: The complete filing bundle remained routed for further scrutiny rather than being returned at the public counter.

state_changes.fact: remained preserved in the district court scrutiny process

beat_sheet.note: No cast character witnessed the internal routing step; it remains deliberate open canon established by the file's continued presence.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Hardik wrote the unidentified case number on a slip and stored it in his drawer for further inquiry.

state_changes.fact: opened a personal inquiry into case one seven six
became the unknowing subject of registry scrutiny

beat_sheet.what_happened: The advocate publicly challenged Sarika to explain what her certification signature represented and reminded Morris that no prior appointment order had been produced.

state_changes.fact: learned publicly that her certification could be treated as proof of proceedings she had not fully recorded
lost control of how Sarika understood her registry role

beat_sheet.what_happened: Morris admitted that he established the forum himself and could not identify an external order appointing him as presiding officer.

state_changes.fact: understood that Morris had no external appointment order
could no longer rely on Sarika's ignorance of the forum's status

beat_sheet.what_happened: Sarika counted fourteen months of salary envelopes and recognized that her signatures had travelled on certified copies outside the room.

state_changes.fact: recognized the possible legal exposure attached to fourteen months of certifications
ceased to regard the clerk position as unquestionably respectable

beat_sheet.what_happened: Sarika asked Morris whether she could be jailed for her role.

state_changes.fact: directly confronted Morris about criminal liability
was required to face the personal cost imposed on his clerk

beat_sheet.what_happened: Morris received Hardik's written demand for his appointment order and learned that he had eleven days to respond.

state_changes.fact: faced an eleven-day deadline to produce a nonexistent appointment order
learned that the district court was formally scrutinizing an award
formally sought documentary proof of the forum's authority

beat_sheet.what_happened: Morris asked Pandit to insert a false appointment into an old court record, and Pandit identified the request as forgery.

state_changes.fact: attempted to obtain a fabricated historical appointment record
refused to share the risk of altering a court register

beat_sheet.what_happened: Pandit stated that each sealed envelope contained a dispute and required outcome, and that Morris had signed twelve awards preserving those outcomes.

state_changes.fact: recognized that access to the pending list had cost him twelve controlled rulings
held specific leverage connecting Morris to predetermined outcomes
were revealed to contain cases and requested operative results rather than money

beat_sheet.what_happened: Pandit refused to assist with the appointment order and demanded the return of the photographed pending list.

state_changes.fact: lost Pandit's assistance while the registry deadline remained active
ended the pending-list arrangement and sought recovery of the leaked material

promise_ledger.how_paid: The advocate forced Sarika to read the certification publicly, and she learned that her signature represented proceedings and certified copies she had not fully recorded or understood.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: what Pandit puts in the monthly sealed envelopes and what the leaked pending list is really costing Morris
promise_ledger.how_paid: Pandit revealed that the envelopes contained selected disputes and required outcomes, and that Morris had preserved those outcomes in twelve signed awards.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: what Hardik will do with the unidentified tribunal case number
promise_ledger.how_paid: Hardik sent a formal demand requiring Morris to produce his appointment order and forum records within eleven days.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: whether Sarika can be jailed for certifying Morris's proceedings
what Hardik will find when he verifies Morris's claimed appointment against the court record

dates_fixed.what: Dhawale's conveyance was due to proceed under the award.
Manjula sought and received an expedited hearing over her recorded share of the family land.
Hardik received and began tracing case one seven six.
Sarika confronted Morris after fourteen months of paid registry work.
Morris received the district registrar's formal demand for appointment records.

periods_fixed.elapsed: six evenings from Morris's first request to his first photographs of the pending list
eight days from Manjula's request to the hearing and judgment
fourteen months from Sarika's hiring to her confrontation about her certification signatures
eleven days allowed from receipt of the registrar's letter to Morris's required response
